summary: Narrowed the self-modification admission defer from whole-invocation to same-cycle scope, added an opt-in --allow-self-modifying override (default off), closed the hard-mode gate gap by explicit transcription, added verify-deploy.sh as a tenth critical path, bumped the verdict schema to orchestrate-batch-admit-v3, and performed the single deliberate redeploy after re-verifying every gate. All 10 phases complete.
decisions_made: A1 dependency-edge exemption asymmetry is explained (unreachable-code argument), not remedied.

--allow-self-modifying defaults off: the narrowing trades a human-paced solo re-run for one automated invocation with zero-review auto-redeploy, which is exactly the automation hazard 1 (verification gap) warns against.
Hard mode gets the self-modification/redeploy gates by explicit transcription rather than a strengthened pointer, since a zero-hit grep proved the prior bare pointer was not reliably followed.
scripts/verify-deploy.sh added to the critical-path list (silent false-PASS risk); scripts/deploy-headless.sh stays excluded (loud primary failure mode).

Scope F (plain multi-task /implement, /research, /plan) restated as an accepted, explained limitation rather than extended, since those commands have no wave/cycle concept for the narrowed trigger to be counted against.
